**GOVLAW — Compliant (at fallback).**

Section 14.3 ("Choice of Law; Arbitration; Venue") is the only governing law and dispute clause in the agreement; the Section 12 source code escrow dispute path (p0105) simply refers back to it, so there is no competing forum provision.

- **Governing law:** State of California — expressly on the accepted list (fallback tier).
- **Forum:** Single-arbitrator AAA commercial arbitration seated in San Francisco County, California, with judgment enforceable in the San Francisco courts — a domestic US seat.
- **Walk-away test:** Not triggered. There is no exclusive foreign venue and no arbitration seated abroad.

Noted but not flagged: the clause routes disputes to domestic arbitration rather than to courts, and it is California rather than the preferred New York law with exclusive jurisdiction in New York County. Because the law is accepted and the seat is domestic, this is a sub-preferred sub-element only, so no redline was proposed. The clause is mutual and non-directional, binding both parties equally.
